source_metadata.scope: Fixed purchased mastery fixtures, not natural XP campaigns or human outcomes. Artificial funding calls are setup only. Original synthetic policies unchanged; optimized is not a proof of optimality. Policy failure is not physical impossibility. Terrain exposure excludes runaway; elapsed includes descent. Exhaustions observed after rescue and stamina loss/gain are net per step, not gross drain.

policy_metadata_interpretation: The generic raw scope sentence about unchanged original policies applies only to names without _aware. Explicit _aware variants are new decision algorithms, with separate source hashes and policy parameter dictionaries. They are never pooled with the original policies.
limitations: Fixed purchased fixtures, not XP campaigns
Failure does not prove physical impossibility
Net stamina change is not gross drain; exhaustion is counted after rescue
Conditional summit duration excludes falls and right-censored timeouts
